splash.tagline: A field QA workspace for seed lots

welcome.title: Meet your field QA workspace
welcome.body: Pick a variety, open the adaptive camera, and turn a tray of seeds into counts, measurements, grade criteria, and synced records.
welcome.cardCameraBody: YOLO26 segmentation samples the tray while the preview stays smooth
welcome.cardTargetBody: LiDAR streams continuously; ArUco relocks when the card is visible
welcome.cardSyncBody: Inspections, media, and metadata stay recoverable for R&D review
welcome.cardWorkspaceBody: Variety-owned A/B/C ranges keep field decisions consistent
